comments.author: Enver
comments.body: Not bad ship at all great acceleration if you have good rowing skill. Armour seems to be biggest flaw here, Custom Commander Corvette have 19 armour and this 12 before mod. But...this have almost triple the crew of CCC so if you can get CCC into melee in esf this ship have HUGE advantage with similar admiral melee skills. Basically, CCC have cannon fight advantage this have the melee advantage. Depend on your style of battle, this is THE best galley for epic sea feud standard class

comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body: Enver is also forgetting not many players use CCCorvette in ESF but it simply isnt the best for ESF. the CCCorvette is a support ship, but most players use commanders heavy caravel or custom commanders caravel because they have great dura, armour, 4 broadside and dont need +crew from improves just to fire all 4. would i use a MBG in esf, no chance, its 1 of the worst ships i can think of to enter ESF. commanders caravel can beat this in melee due to having more crew than a MBG, and can easily kill MBG in 2 shots because MBG dura and armour is way too low.
